transcript.user: My qualifying income was exactly £50,000 in 2024-25. Do I need MTD from April 2026?
transcript.assistant:
No — qualifying income of exactly £50,000 for 2024-25 does not bring you into Making Tax Digital under that band. Official guidance: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-out-if-and-when-you-need-to-use-making-tax-digital-for-income-tax
